newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Prime Minister-designate Victor Ciorbea will present on Wednesday the cabinet list and the governing programme before the parliament's joint houses.
The MPs will vote to install the cabinet and approve the programme at the end of debates starting at 1600 hours local.
* The candidates for portfolios in Ciorbea's government were heard yesterday by the parliament's standing commissions and got their approval. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
